notes.title: Linux & Steam Play support
notes.notes:
This post is regarding [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/221410/announcements/detail/1696055855739350561]Valve recently introducing a new version of Steam Play[/url].

In short the main take of that news is "Windows games with no Linux version currently available can now be installed and run directly from the Linux Steam client, complete with native Steamworks and OpenVR support."

Previously I've heard Wine (Steam Play uses a modified distribution of Wine, called Proton) users having some luck running Gun Bombers. Now an active player (thanks Miikka!) told me that Gun Bombers works very well indeed through the new Steam Play.

Miikka was initially experiencing slowdowns but got over them after using the following Steam Launch Command: [i]PROTON_USE_WINED3D11=1[/i]

As a developer this is great news because typically a separate Linux version would have to be tested and compiled in order for the game to be played on Linux.

I'm interested to hear from others too that have tried Gun Bombers on Linux and/or the new Steam Play and how your experience was.

notes.title: ver. 1.0.0.8 - Alone In The Dark
notes.notes:
First off, welcome all new players that the Steam summer sale brought forward! Coincidentally I received further feedback and motivation to look into something that has needed an overhaul for a long time - the Peekaboo mode. While fun, the biggest issue has been that it too easily turns into a camp frenzy where players hide in their own little corner of the map waiting for unsuspecting prey. Well, things are about to change.

In the new Peekaboo mode the areas you discover will be hidden shortly after. You will for the most part be constantly in the dark. You will however be able to see where your clones or team mates are just like before. At the same time the standard visiblity radius around you is slightly bigger. That's it really. Doesn't sound like much but it completely changes the dynamics of this mode. Hope you enjoy and as always keep that feedback coming!

Changes
[list]
[*]Peekaboo mode is scarier than ever
[/list]

notes.title: ver. 1.0.0.7 - Infinite Possibilities
notes.notes:
It's really nice to be back working on a more normal update. The past week has been great listening to feedback and seeing your custom maps hit the workshop!

In general the map editor has opened up possibilities to new forms of gameplay. To support this we've given you more editor objects and game settings for a wider variety of custom games. Enjoy!

A special mention goes to never before seen objects (usable only in editor for custom games); Wood Block and Wall Doors (with switches). Wood Block is the younger and lighter brother of Steel Block. Wall Doors on the other hand are solid walls that can be opened up with the flick of a switch.

New

[*]Map editor: Rubble (broken rock) object. Rubble is no longer generated automatically for custom maps
[*]Map editor: Hidden Lava object. Hidden Lava is no longer generated automatically for custom maps
[*]Map editor: Wood Block object
[*]Map editor: Wall Door and Wall Door Switch object
[*]Map editor: Medbay object
[*]Map editor: Shop object
[*]Game setting: Infinite Lives
[*]Game setting: Infinite Ammo
[*]Game setting: No Loot Drops
[*]Game setting: Skip Shop
[*]Next map information will reveal the custom map name (if applicable)
[*]Hide scores at end of Endless mode to get a better view of the map
[*]Map editor: Notice regarding Steam 2MB max file size for images
[/list]

[*]Water tiles do not generate correctly on some cases near the border

[*]Rail tracks have winter tiles when placed on base floors (on Winter theme)

notes.title: ver. 1.0.0.1 - Bend It Like Beckham
notes.notes:
The first update after full release brings you a new game mode that absolutely no one requested or expected (but secretly hoped for?). I've been playing Rocket League a fair bit lately and I suppose that triggered me into creating a soccer mode for Gun Bombers as well. What can I say, it's soccer GB style! It has had a limited amount of testing so far so please let us know how you like it.

Having had the opportunity to use smoke as cover for a while now it's pretty evident that while the Smoke Bomb is useful in some scenarios the Smoke Grenade is not that great. So we've removed the Smoke Grenade and replaced it with a Flash Grenade that can temporarily blind your enemy (and yourself if within line of sight!). At the same time we've reduced the cost of non-lethal weapons to encourage their use more.

Occasionally we have users experiencing strange graphical anomalies. The obvious cause is having a computer that doesn't meet the minimum specs but sometimes these appear with top of the line computers as well. GameMaker (which Gun Bombers is built on) doesn't offer many graphical options but I've added one to this version which let's you choose the Vertex Buffer method. If you were to ask me what this actually does I would look you with a blank stare but if it can help someone run the game smoother then who cares!

Last but not least we've implemented a few balance changes thanks to in part scirmast's great feedback on the forums.

notes.title: ver. 1.0.0.0 - Goodbye Early Access
notes.notes:
It's with great pleasure, excitement, relief and a little bit sadness when we mark the game as 1.0 and leave Early Access behind.

During the Early Access period we put out 20 updates including 2 hotfix patches. That translates to approximately one update every 2 weeks so in that sense everything went 'to plan'. We shot over the estimated time of 6 months by a few months but that's because we ended up adding more features than anticipated. Overall it was quite an experience and I want to thank everyone who provided valuable feedback during this stage.

Going forward the game will be maintained post release whenever called for. I really hope you enjoy Gun Bombers, a game that has been a passion project for almost 3 years!

Fixes

[*]Enemies get stuck with dead player bodies (CTB mode only)
[*]Exploding enemy (upon exploding) only harms the host player
[*]Player game status sometimes showed as 0
[/list]

notes.title: ver. 0.1.8.3 - Size Matters
notes.notes:
A popular request since the early days has been having a smaller arena to play in. The standard play area can seem big for the action hungry players or when it's just you and a couple of friends. Fear not as you now have the option to play in a smaller map, ideally suited for 4 players or less but by all means go crazy with more if it's chaos you're after! All current multiplayer modes support the small map size.

A couple of other tasks that have been sitting on my to-do list for a long time have been completed as well. Ice can now break so be careful out there! Fluctuating Market game option on the other hand enables variable Shop prices - Better stock up on those discount Nukes!

Finally there's been a few changes on the Endless mode. Turns out the end-game was pretty much broken and you could go on forever with a certain setup. Thanks to "Teams Medic" who was pushing me to try harder and harder for that leaderboard top spot. I suicided at 43min but have since deleted that score. I'll keep tweaking this mode until we find a nice sweet spot - something that is challenging but fair. Note that leaderboard scores are likely to reset before reaching v1.0.

New
[list]
[*]Smaller map size available
[*]Ice can break on winter map
[*]New game setting: Fluctuating Market (Shop prices can go up or down each round)
[*]Leaderboards page
[/list]
Changes
[list]
[*]Turret and Bazooka shots will fly over mines
[*]Removed auto-ready functionality as this caused more confusion than helped
[*]Game settings are better grouped now
[*]Endless mode: Additional spawn location
[*]Endless mode: Spawn locations can be disabled for a short time
[*]Endless mode: New enemy type
[*]Endless mode: Exploding enemy explodes on contact with bombs and steel blocks
[*]Endless mode: Base location randomly closer to the middle of the map
[/list]
Fixes
[list]
[*]Fireball enemy was not aiming correctly for all targets
[*]Molotov sometimes goofed (fingers crossed this one is finally fixed!)
[*]Bullets sometimes end up inside ground (another long time issue, hoping finally fixed as well!)
[/list]

notes.title: ver. 0.1.7.8 - All For One And One For All
notes.notes:
TDM is here! All the existing game modes are now available to be played in teams (Blue vs. Red). Same rules apply but you ultimately win or lose as a team. To celebrate we have also increased maximum players to 10.

In other news the Clone has seen a much needed makeover, Steel Blocks are more in your way, there's more balance with loot drops and last but not least you can throw your inventory away!

New
[list]
[*]Team Classic, Team Peekaboo and Team Naked game modes
[*]Ability to drop current Primary or Secondary weapon as loot (Z and X as default keys)
[*]Top players are likely to drop better loot and vice versa for Bottom players
[/list]
Changes
[list]
[*]Clone 2.0
[*]Support for 10 players
[*]Steel Blocks can't be picked up anymore
[*]Mines are visible to yourself and your team members
[*]Mines are visible to everyone at the end of the round
[*]Landmine cost changed from $100 to $150
[*]Reduced Player knockback effect
[/list]
